## Selection Lens

- Short path from API output to a paid outcome
- Useful for a specific customer, not just a general-purpose dataset
- Feeds a workflow someone would pay to automate, monitor, or improve
- Supports repeatable deliverables, subscriptions, or clear one-time service packages

## Best Monetization Paths

- Start with a done-for-you report or audit
- Turn repeated analysis into monitoring and alerting
- Productize the workflow once one niche keeps paying for the same output
- Prefer narrow pain and believable outcomes over giant all-in-one dashboards

# Legacy API Dump

This folder contains the original cloned material from the previous mega-list style repository.

## What Is Inside

- category-level API dump folders
- the original generated root README at [README-original-api-mega-list.md](./README-original-api-mega-list.md)
- the generator-related `settings/` files
- auxiliary source docs such as `FOLLOW_CREATOR.md`

## Why It Was Archived

- the old structure was too large and too noisy for a curated business-building repo
- the raw source is still useful for mining additional APIs later
- existing affiliate links are preserved in the archived source material

## Primary Curated Experience

Use the main repo content instead:

- [../../README.md](../../README.md)
- [../../apis/README.md](../../apis/README.md)
- [../../playbooks/README.md](../../playbooks/README.md)
